methodology.name: Finite-scenario model short saturation progress
methodology.peak_history: t-20 through t; progress starts at observation320 to retain full valid peak window
methodology.risk: EWMA60 daily log-return std adjust=False bias=False; net=clip(signal*.10/max(vol*sqrt252,.05),-2,2); Wilder ATR20 seed mean first20 TR
methodology.remaining: max(0,q[t]-min(projected q days1..20))*P[t]*100; max core over flat/down1/down2/sudden_down1 and range factors0.5/1/1.5; other models central range only
methodology.progress: core_short/(core_short+remaining)*100 only when core_short>=10; finite-scenario short saturation, not probability or true capacity ceiling; null outside short regime
methodology.paths: 20 sessions: flat, loglinear -1sigma20, -2sigma20, +1sigma20, sudden -1sigma20 day1 thenflat; sigma20=frozen current daily vol*sqrt20
methodology.synthetic_range: open=previousclose; frozen median last20 (high-low)/close times rangefactor; range=max(fraction*newclose,abs(close-open)); symmetric padding; indicators and volatility update recursively
methodology.flow: (future q-current q)*current price*100; positive buying, negative selling; remaining is maximum extra directional selling, not gross turnover
methodology.candidate: short saturation progress>=80 with core_short>=10; exclude following20 sessions; comparator short saturation progress<50 with core_short>=10 separately declustered20
methodology.validation: nextsession open to close t+5/10/20; actual further20 selling=max(0,q[t]-min actual q[t+1:t+20])*P[t]*100; train signal before2025 AND complete20session endpoint before2025; earlier signals crossing2025 labelled splitboundary_excluded and omitted from train/holdout; holdout signal2025plus; full includes boundary events; fixed threshold80 unchanged
methodology.attribution: Conceptual CTA trend/volatility framework; parameters and finite scenarios are this trial design, not literal replication of source models
limitations: Model proxy; no validated actual CTA holdings or capacity estimate.
Observational historical test; small candidate counts.
No transaction costs, distributions, cross-asset capital allocation, subscriptions, leverage changes or trader discretion.
Finite frozen-range paths; unmodeled trajectories can produce additional selling.
methodology.model_band: primary short saturation min/max among models individually active short>=10; nActiveModels reports eligible count; core uses all3rangefactors, others centralrange
methodology.selling_progress: supplemental sold/(sold+remaining)*100 only when sold>=10; sold is current-price-marked inventory drawdown from past20 peak shares, not cumulative sales
methodology.objective_correction: Primary numerator corrected from historical inventory drawdown to current short exposure to measure short saturation; previous all-regime ratio retained as supplemental selling_progress; threshold80 unchanged.

short_score_example.selection: maximum available historical short score; display example only, not candidate selection
